links.outcome: Readability of AI-simplified PROMs against sixth-grade standard, and content fidelity
links.effect: 18 of 19 linguistic parameters improved (p<.05); 7 of 9 grade-level indices met sixth-grade compliance; Gunning Fog and FORCAST did not; 59.7% had at least one content error.
links.quote: About 7 of 9 grade level indices met NIH/AMA sixth-grade readability compliance after ChatGPT revision.

links.outcome: Reading level of spine PROMs after ChatGPT revision versus sixth-grade target
links.effect: Word count fell 18%; 7 of 9 grade-level indices reached sixth-grade level or lower; Gunning Fog and FORCAST stayed above threshold.
links.quote: The 2 indices that did not reach the sixth-grade threshold were the Gunning Fog Index and the FORCAST Index.

links.outcome: Content errors in unedited LLM-rewritten validated instruments
links.effect: 46 of 77 PROMs (59.7%) contained at least one content-related error; response scales altered in 23%, recall timeframes omitted in 18%, items combined in 16%.
links.quote: Despite improvements in readability, 46 of the 77 PROMs (59.7%) contained at least one content-related error following ChatGPT revision ( Table 2 ).

links.outcome: Specialized-domain errors in AI output detected by expert spine surgeon review
links.effect: Expert review found errors in 59.7% of revised PROMs, including altered response scales (23%) and lost recall timeframes (18%).
links.quote: Content fidelity was assessed by a fellowship-trained spine surgeon with experience in PROM implementation and spine outcomes research.

links.outcome: Accuracy of AI-revised PROMs against original validated instruments as reference
links.effect: 59.7% of revised PROMs had at least one error versus the original instrument; most common errors were altered response scales (23%), omitted timeframes (18%), merged items (16%).
links.quote: The most common errors involved alteration or removal of validated response scales (23%), omission or simplification of key time frames (18%), and inappropriate combination of multiple items into a single prompt (16%).

unlisted_practices: Psychometric equivalence testing and patient comprehension testing (cognitive interviewing) before adopting AI-modified validated instruments
AI-assisted draft revision followed by clinician-led fidelity review for validated measurement instruments
